notes: Set-up triage fix: parts on your truck with no Min/Max are no longer dumped into one giant Request. They get their own "Set up" list (Home, Inventory, and your Daily plan). For each: KEEP it (set a Min/Max — the only thing that becomes a request to your parts dept) or RETURN to shop, which drops it straight into your Check-IN cart so you can send the parts dept a clean list to pull off your truck. Requests now counts only your real add/change/remove requests.
